u2.line:
printf '
__DV_BEGIN_<nonce>__
'; { uname -a; uname -m; cat /proc/cmdline; cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null || true; }; _dv_rc=$?; printf '
__DV_END_<nonce>__:%s
' "$_dv_rc"

printf '
__DV_BEGIN_<nonce>__
'; { printf 'shell=%s
' "$0"; id; [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] && echo LIVE_ROOT_UID_VERIFIED; if grep -Eiq '^built[[:space:]]+with[[:space:]]+dustbuilder[[:space:]]*$' /etc/motd /etc/banner 2>/dev/null; then echo PERSISTENT_ROOT_PROOF; fi; true; }; _dv_rc=$?; printf '
__DV_END_<nonce>__:%s
' "$_dv_rc"

printf '
__DV_BEGIN_<nonce>__
'; { _dv_ok=1; for x in tar sha256sum base64 stat file cut wc readlink; do command -v "$x" 2>/dev/null || { printf '%s MISSING
' "$x"; _dv_ok=0; }; done; [ "$_dv_ok" = 1 ]; }; _dv_rc=$?; printf '
__DV_END_<nonce>__:%s
' "$_dv_rc"

printf '
__DV_BEGIN_<nonce>__
'; { exec 3>&1; _dv_bytes=$({ tar cf - /mnt/private/ /mnt/misc/ /etc/OTA_Key_pub.pem /etc/publickey.pem; printf 'DV_TAR_RC %s
' "$?" >&3; } | wc -c); _dv_wc=$?; exec 3>&-; set -- $_dv_bytes; _dv_bytes=${1-}; _dv_fields=$#; set -- $(stat -f -c '%a %S' /tmp 2>/dev/null); _dv_blocks=${1-}; _dv_block_size=${2-}; _dv_stat_fields=$#; _dv_ok=1; case "$_dv_bytes:$_dv_blocks:$_dv_block_size" in *[!0-9:]*) _dv_ok=0;; esac; [ "$_dv_fields" = 1 ] && [ "$_dv_stat_fields" = 2 ] || _dv_ok=0; [ "$_dv_wc" = 0 ] || _dv_ok=0; _dv_free=$((_dv_blocks*_dv_block_size)); printf 'DV_ARCHIVE_BYTES %s
DV_WC_RC %s
DV_TMP_FREE_BYTES %s
' "$_dv_bytes" "$_dv_wc" "$_dv_free"; [ "$_dv_ok" = 1 ]; }; _dv_rc=$?; printf '
__DV_END_<nonce>__:%s
' "$_dv_rc"

printf '
__DV_BEGIN_<nonce>__
'; { _dv_ok=1; for p in /mnt/private /mnt/misc /mnt/private/ULI/factory/config.txt /mnt/private/ULI/factory/did.txt /mnt/private/ULI/factory/key.txt /etc/OTA_Key_pub.pem /etc/publickey.pem; do if [ -e "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ]; then printf '%s PRESENT ' "$p"; stat -c '%F %s %a' "$p" 2>/dev/null || _dv_ok=0; else printf '%s MISSING
' "$p"; _dv_ok=0; fi; done; [ "$_dv_ok" = 1 ]; }; _dv_rc=$?; printf '
__DV_END_<nonce>__:%s
' "$_dv_rc"

printf '
__DV_BEGIN_<nonce>__
'; { for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do [ "$(cat "$p/comm" 2>/dev/null)" = valetudo ] || continue; _dv_run=$(readlink "$p/exe" 2>/dev/null) || continue; case "$_dv_run" in /usr/local/bin/valetudo|/data/valetudo) ;; *) continue;; esac; _dv_rsize=$(stat -Lc %s "$p/exe" 2>/dev/null) || continue; _dv_rhash=$(sha256sum "$p/exe" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1) || continue; printf 'VALETUDO_RUNNING %s %s %s
' "$_dv_run" "$_dv_rsize" "$_dv_rhash"; done; for v in /usr/local/bin/valetudo /data/valetudo; do if [ -f "$v" ] && [ -x "$v" ] && [ ! -L "$v" ]; then _dv_vsize=$(stat -c %s "$v" 2>/dev/null) || continue; _dv_vhash=$(sha256sum "$v" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1) || continue; printf 'VALETUDO_EXECUTABLE %s %s %s
' "$v" "$_dv_vsize" "$_dv_vhash"; printf 'VALETUDO_FILE %s: ' "$v"; file "$v" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; true; }; _dv_rc=$?; printf '
__DV_END_<nonce>__:%s
' "$_dv_rc"

printf '
__DV_BEGIN_<nonce>__
'; { ip addr 2>/dev/null || ifconfig 2>/dev/null || true; wget -S -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1/ 2>&1 || true; }; _dv_rc=$?; printf '
__DV_END_<nonce>__:%s
' "$_dv_rc"

u3.line:
printf '
__DV_BEGIN_<nonce>__
'; { umask 077; mkdir <private> && chmod 700 <private> && [ ! -L <private> ] && [ "$(stat -c %u <private>)" = 0 ] && [ "$(stat -c %a <private>)" = 700 ] && tar cf <private>/identity.tar /mnt/private/ /mnt/misc/ /etc/OTA_Key_pub.pem /etc/publickey.pem && chmod 600 <private>/identity.tar && [ ! -L <private>/identity.tar ] && [ -f <private>/identity.tar ] && [ "$(stat -c %u <private>/identity.tar)" = 0 ] && [ "$(stat -c %a <private>/identity.tar)" = 600 ] && [ "$(stat -c %s <private>/identity.tar)" = 10240 ] && printf 'DV_ARCHIVE %s ' "$(stat -c %s <private>/identity.tar)" && sha256sum <private>/identity.tar | cut -d' ' -f1; }; _dv_rc=$?; printf '
__DV_END_<nonce>__:%s
' "$_dv_rc"
